fields.description: The Mammotion LUBA 3 AWD 1500 is a wire-free all-wheel-drive mower for lawns up to 0.37 acre. Tri-Fusion positioning combines a 360° LiDAR, NetRTK and dual-camera AI vision, with 70 m detection range, 200,000 cloud points per second and 0.4 in claimed precision, without an RTK antenna or base station. Mammotion publishes an 80% (38.6°) slope rating, a 15 Ah battery for 215 min per charge, 41 lbs mass, IPX6, 70 dB or less noise, 1.0-2.7 in standard or 2.2-4.0 in high cutting height and 0.37, 0.75 or 1.25 acre coverage for the 1500, 3000 and 5000. It handles 300+ obstacles, 100 mowing zones, DropMow, anti-fall and lift detection, 70 cm gaps and up to 10 cloud-backed maps. The reviewed page publishes no charging time, cutting width or area rate.

companyFocus.name: Mammotion
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch162. Mammotion pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. LUBA mini AWD and LUBA mini 2 AWD are separate models; YUKA 2000 is distinct from the YUKA mini 2. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions. All USPs, complete portfolios and leadership remain unproven.
highlights: Mammotion is a wire-free robotic lawn mower manufacturer whose current US range includes the LUBA 3 AWD, LUBA mini AWD, LUBA mini 2 AWD, YUKA mini 2 and YUKA mini.
The company cites Frost & Sullivan research that ranked it the world's number one perimeter wire-free robotic lawn mower brand by global sales revenue from July 2024 to June 2025.
Mammotion reports more than 750,000 global families, 1.5 million social followers and sales in more than 30 countries and regions.
Its LUBA AWD series is rated for 80% (38.6°) slopes and the YUKA series for 45% (24°), using LiDAR, NetRTK and AI vision positioning.
The reviewed pages publish an up to three-year warranty, 30-day returns, free shipping over 99 USD and local repair service.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: LUBA 3 AWD, LUBA mini AWD, LUBA mini 2 AWD, YUKA mini 2 1000H, YUKA mini and YUKA 2000 are six separate current or recent mower models, not tiers or cut-down versions of one another. The catalog rows are four distinct models.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: The US LUBA 3 AWD page publishes 2,399 USD for the 1500/1500H version, 2,799 USD for the 3000 and 3,299 USD for the 5000. The US LUBA mini AWD page publishes 1,999 USD for the 1500H and 1,599 USD for the 800H. The US YUKA mini 2 page publishes 1,399 USD for the 1000H. The EU YUKA page publishes 1,699 EUR for the YUKA 2000 and lists it as sold out; the catalog 1,799 USD figure is not published on the reviewed US store, whose old YUKA URL redirects to the YUKA mini 2 page.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: The LUBA 3 AWD page publishes 41 lbs. The reviewed LUBA mini AWD, YUKA mini 2 and YUKA 2000 pages publish no mass. The catalog values of about 25 kg, 11 kg and about 22 kg are not supported and are cleared.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: No reviewed Mammotion page publishes product dimensions. The catalog size classes are retained as directory filter buckets, not manufacturer dimensions.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed Mammotion page publishes a payload rating; these are lawn mowers without a manipulator or load rating.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: The LUBA 3 AWD page publishes a 15 Ah battery and 215 min runtime per charge. The LUBA mini AWD page publishes a 6.1 Ah battery and 160 min runtime per charge. The YUKA mini 2 page publishes a 6.1 Ah battery and 2,690 sq ft coverage per charge, not a runtime in minutes. The YUKA 2000 page publishes no battery capacity or runtime. The catalog values of about 8 hours, 480 min and about 90 min are not supported by the reviewed pages and are cleared or replaced.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Mammotion describes Tri-Fusion positioning, NetRTK, AI vision, obstacle avoidance, DropMow, anti-fall, lift detection and zone management. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification or proof of unsupervised operation.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.

comparison-evidence-check.scope: Exact claim/source/status delivery; runtime tests separately verify comparison rendering and load behavior.
